name: underfoot
description: Hide in a hill town from a giant nearly three kilometres tall, under seven looks. WebGL2, no engine.

scripts.build: node tools/build.mjs dist/index.html --tpl=page/looks.html && node tools/build.mjs dist/game.html --tpl=page/game.html
scripts.shots:cycle: npm run build:test && node tools/shot.mjs out/test.html out/cycle plans/cycle.json
